context: A uni student helps a teen friend plan a drama-club shoot
purpose: Teach: 焼肉/百貨店/デッキ/蛙/水槽/ソフトウエア/小道具/浜松

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先輩、演劇部の撮影、浜松のロケ地でやることになりました！
lines.en: Senpai, the drama club's shoot is going to happen at a location in Hamamatsu!
lines.style: Excited teen sharing news with admired upperclassman

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: おお、浜松か。じゃあ小道具とか機材はどうするの？
lines.en: Oh, Hamamatsu, huh. So what are you doing about props and equipment?
lines.style: Casual uni student tone, slightly older-brother vibe

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: それが問題で…舞台で使う水槽と、中に入れる蛙のフィギュアが必要なんです。
lines.en: That's the problem... we need an aquarium for the stage, and a frog figurine to put inside it.
lines.style: Worried teen explaining the tricky logistics

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 蛙のフィギュア？駅前の百貨店のおもちゃ売り場に置いてあったと思うよ。
lines.en: A frog figurine? I think they had some at the toy section of the department store near the station.
lines.style: Helpful uni student offering practical knowledge

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ほんとですか！あと、編集用のソフトウエアも先輩のおすすめを教えてほしくて。
lines.en: Really! Also, I wanted to ask you to recommend some editing software for us.
lines.style: Eager teen asking for technical guidance

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うちのサークルで使ってるやつ貸せるよ。撮影は屋外のデッキでやるんだっけ？
lines.en: I can lend you what our circle uses. You're shooting outside on the deck, right?
lines.style: Generous uni senpai casually offering resources

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、ウッドデッキの上で。終わったらみんなで焼肉に行く予定なんです！
lines.en: Yes, on the wood deck. After we wrap, everyone's planning to go out for yakiniku!
lines.style: Bright teen sharing the fun post-shoot plan

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 焼肉いいね。先輩も呼んでくれたら、機材の運搬も手伝うよ。
lines.en: Yakiniku sounds great. If you invite me along, I'll help haul the equipment too.
lines.style: Playful uni student bargaining with warm humor

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: もちろん来てください！助かります、本当にありがとうございます！
lines.en: Of course you have to come! That'd be such a huge help, thank you so much!
lines.style: Grateful teen with genuine relief and excitement
